markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement and typical image quality all align [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal >99%, Benign <1% | Strongly favors Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class, separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.997 / 76th percentile | Typical; not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class as production |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Normal [F5] | Mostly agree; one Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; lowers invasive association · Weak
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; lowers invasive association · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Low score; slight push toward invasive · Weak
- **Immune cell fraction** (regions 3, 4, 8) · context · 19% of nuclei; above every reference image [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules and mitoses are Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Small test set (132): calibration error CI reaches 0.18, so >99% may overstate certainty.
- Cell data cover 3 of 12 regions; tumor nuclei flagged insufficient.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 4, 8**: Review the inflammatory infiltrate; its fraction exceeds every reference image.
2. **Regions 8, 9**: Confirm normal lobule architecture; the lobule concept failed its spot check.
3. **Regions 2, 5, 6**: Confirm gland formation is benign, not infiltrative.
